title: Nonvanishing of the lifted frequency
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices, and let $\gamma$ be a nonzero $\mathbb{F}_2$-valued frequency on the indices outside $J$. Extend $\gamma$ to all $n$ coordinates by assigning frequency zero on $J$. The resulting frequency is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
$\gamma$ is a nonzero frequency on the indices outside $J$
